text:
alex: Pagerbot fired: eu-west1 GPU pool queue >= 85% for 5m, OOM/retry spikes. Paging oncall.
pagerbot: Incident INC-2026-247 created (severity: P2). Notifying: @ryan, @marta. Runbook: /runbooks/gpu-capacity
marta: seeing the same in console, pods piling in Pending with GPU-sched error. Any immediate mitigation? :eyes:
ryan: can we shift non-critical traffic (batch embeddings) off eu-west1 to eu-west3 and asia2 temporarily? eu-west3 has some spare but lower GPU count.
sre_lead: agree with partial shift. Also we should suppress low-urgency capacity alerts to avoid page storm while we investigate. Propose temporary pagerbot tweak: capacity_warning -> delay 10m and route to #eng-oncall-digest instead of pages.
julia: if we shift, enable fallback to the quantized model variant in eu-west3 to reduce memory pressure. Add a note to the ticket for output-quality check.
alex: starting controlled shift. Command:
```
# shift 30% of routing for embeddings from eu-west1 -> eu-west3 over 5m
POST /admin/traffic-shift
{
  "from": "eu-west1",
  "to": "eu-west3",
  "routes": ["embeddings"],
  "percent": 30,
  "ramp_minutes": 5
}
```
alex: applying now, will monitor latency and queue length.
infra-bot: Started traffic shift job job-7861. Stage=rolling, target=30%, status=warming caches. eu-west3 GPUs: 62% baseline usage.
ryan: eu-west3 currently has smaller batch capacity; recommend reducing batch_size floor for embeddings to 8 to avoid long tails. Command to apply:
```
PATCH /config/batching
{"service":"embeddings","batch_size_max":64,"batch_size_min":8}
```
marta: acknowledged. I'm going to open a short-lived cost bucket for burst capacity — estimate ~$3k/day if we enable extra capacity. Approving burst for next 12h.
sre_lead: ack. Also update pagerbot routing: add temporary rule so only P1 pages go to phone and P2 go to slack digest. I'll patch the rule and note in the incident. Alex, set handoff: I'll take primary at 09:00 UTC, ryan remains secondary.
alex: done. Handoff scheduled. Last status: queue reduced to 68% in eu-west1, eu-west3 warming fine, no user-facing errors reported. Will keep monitoring and close incident if stable for 30m.
pagerbot: Incident INC-2026-247 updated: severity unchanged. Next update in 10m or on manual close.
